name: pre-market-brief
prompt: Pre-market brief. Read-only: use the tradedesk search tool to find the API, then via execute read account.holdings(), account.funds() and market.quote() for the holdings. Overnight news is NOT available; use market data only and say so. Summarise holdings, available funds and notable price moves. Do not call trade.*; never place, modify or cancel orders.

name: eod-review
prompt: End-of-day review. Read-only: via execute read account.positions(), account.trades(), account.orders() and risk.status(). Report today's P&L, open positions, orders placed against the risk limits and kill switch state. Do not call trade.*; never place, modify or cancel orders.

name: weekly-backtest-refresh
prompt: Weekly backtest refresh. Use search to read the backtest API, then re-run the saved strategy backtests with backtest.run over the trailing year and report metrics against last week. Backtests only; do not call trade.*; never place, modify or cancel orders.

name: paper-crypto-gemini
prompt: Paper-trading check for BTCUSD. Use the tradedesk search tool first to read the API, then work through execute. Step 1: call risk.status(). If mode is not "paper", or killSwitch is true, or remainingOrders is 0, place nothing: report the status and stop. Step 2: use market.search({ query: "BTCUSD", exchange: "CRYPTO" }) to confirm the exact crypto symbol, then market.history for that symbol with exchange "CRYPTO", interval "1h" and a start/end range (YYYY-MM-DD) covering at least the last 3 days, so you have at least 21 candles. Step 3: apply exactly ONE rule: compute the simple moving average of the last 20 closes; if the latest close is above it, BUY; if below it, SELL; if equal, do nothing. Step 4: place AT MOST ONE paper order with trade.place: exchange CRYPTO, MARKET order, quantity 1 (never more than 1), product as allowed by risk.status limits.allowedProducts (NRML or MIS). If the order is denied or errors, report the exact error text and do NOT retry, modify or place any other order. Always end with your reasoning: the latest close, the SMA(20) value, the rule outcome and what you did. Never touch live mode; never use trade.cancel, trade.closePosition or trade.modify.
